description: A dietary supplement product contains an opaque proprietary blend reported in the NHANES Dietary Supplement Database.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Time the relationship was created or last updated.

common_properties.name: quantity
common_properties.description: Amounts of the blend contained in the product.
common_properties.notes: One element per contributor. `quantity`, `unit`, `operator` are index-aligned (element i is the i-th contributing ingredient's amount/unit/operator).

common_properties.name: unit
common_properties.description: Raw NHANES amount-unit codes; the modeling documentation provides no label table for these codes.
common_properties.notes: One element per contributor. `quantity`, `unit`, `operator` are index-aligned (element i is the i-th contributing ingredient's amount/unit/operator).

common_properties.name: operator
common_properties.notes: One element per contributor. `quantity`, `unit`, `operator` are index-aligned (element i is the i-th contributing ingredient's amount/unit/operator).

source_contributions.scope: Proprietary-blend ingredients reported for dietary supplement products in NHANES Ingredient Information (DSII), where a corresponding Blend is available.
source_contributions.description: NHANES is published by the CDC / National Center for Health Statistics. DSII records which blends a product contains and the corresponding amounts. Ingredient category is absent for these blend relationships.
